summary: Bootstrap Performance standard and define delivery slices

delivery.outcome: The standalone repository has immutable governance that actually verifies, bounded tickets and an auditable plan for Performance v1.
nonGoals: Define the normative performance contract in the bootstrap diff
Implement an optimizer or execute a refactoring
Grant deployment, merge, secret-access or production-mutation authority
Merge without independent trusted current-head approval
Upgrade the adopted new-project governance standard to 0.18.x

architecture.decision: Keep bootstrap governance separate from the normative contract, validator and CI workstreams, and hold the adopted governance pack byte-identical to its pinned revision rather than editing lock-managed files in place.
architecture.rollback: Revert the restore commit; the trusted lock is never modified, so the pinned baseline stays reachable.

commands: python3 -c "import json,hashlib; lock=json.load(open('.governance/manifest.lock.json'))['managedFiles']; print(sum(hashlib.sha256(open(f,'rb').read()).hexdigest()!=d for f,d in lock.items()))"
